title: Math Pathways - Implementation
before:
Considerations for Secondary Math Pathways Implementation

Strengthening pathways through secondary mathematics has the potential to benefit individual students and schools as a whole. Planning for the implementation of math pathways requires vision and leadership and must include consideration of the culture, resources, and needs of individual school administrative units (SAU). Embracing implementation of math pathways involves administrators and educators collaborating to design mathematics course pathways and curricula that will meet the needs of students in their SAU. 

The resources below include examples of pathways designed by educators in other states and are intended to inform the thinking of SAUs in Maine as they explore and plan for secondary math pathways.

Math Pathways Resources for Implementation

 

Profile of a Maine SAU

MSAD11 has done in-depth planning, taking a long view on developing and supporting pathways through mathematics for their students. Source: R1CC, Maine DOE, MCSS, and Maine Math Pathways Working Group Members.

notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Make a bold line a real heading
decisions.why: "Considerations for Secondary Math Pathways Implementation" is a paragraph in bold type. It reads as a heading and is spaced like one, but it is not in the page's outline, a screen reader does not announce it, and the contents list cannot link to it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Give the sub-headings their rule
decisions.why: 1 sub-heading is plain bold text. The design has a treatment for them — a teal rule down the left and a line across — and it had never been used on any page, because it needs a wrapper an author would have to know about.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.

decisions.label: Match the heading treatments to the final levels
decisions.why: 1 heading was wearing the wrong treatment for its level — a section header round a sub-heading or the reverse — because the wrapper was chosen before the outline was finished.
